content.text:
I found no contractual NS-500 discount for Acme Manufacturing on 2022-10-01, so I can't give a maximum for that date. The knowledge base has no term covering it, and all of Acme's recorded NS-500 discount entitlements start later.

Acme Manufacturing is recorded as **Acme Mfg. Holdings** (also listed as "Acme" and "ACME Manufacturing"). Its NS-500 Industrial Controller discount terms are:

| Term | Valid | Maximum discount |
|---|---|---|
| Exception EXC-ACME-NS500-10 | 2023-04-01 → 2025-03-31 | 10% of list price |
| Acme NS-500 Strategic Account Exception (replaced EXC-ACME-NS500-10; approved by David Morgan on 2025-03-20) | 2025-04-01 → 2028-03-31 | 15% of list price |

- **Nothing on record for 2022-10-01.** Filtering Acme's facts to that date returns nothing. The earliest NS-500 entitlement starts on 2023-04-01, six months later.
- **The ACME-SA-2023 record is empty.** It exists in the knowledge base but has no facts, dates or discount terms attached.
- **One undated item.** A customer document signed 2025-03-22 says Acme "is eligible for discounts of up to" something on NS-500, but the graph captured no percentage or dates for it. Given the signing date, it most likely matches the 2025 exception rather than anything from 2022.

A pricing exception only covers the dates it names, so neither 10% nor 15% applies to 2022-10-01. Any discount request for that date would count as standard pricing, unless someone can produce a contract that was in force then.
